notes.title: Update notes for 2.32
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new update has gone live today (2.32) which updates the game engine and fixes three ending achievements that had stopped working. If you recently played the game and these achievements didn't unlock for you, please update and load the game. The missing achievements should unlock immediately! :)

Apologies for the inconvenience and thank you to those who alerted me to the problem. If anyone is still having issues, please contact me at contact (at) kinmoku (dot) games and I will take a look.

Thanks again for supporting One Night Stand!

notes.title: Update notes for 2.31
notes.notes:
Hello,

Update 2.31 contains a fix for Steam achievements. Please update your game for achievements to work correctly from now on.

Apologies for the inconvenience. This was caused by creating last week's build – 2.3 – on a different computer.

Thanks again for supporting One Night Stand!

notes.title: One Night Stand – Update 2.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it's been a while! ːons_shewavesː

A small new update has just released for One Night Stand. It features:


  A clearer credits page
  Translation fixes
  ...and a whole new look for Kinmoku (that's me!)

Please update so you have the latest version of the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26739532/7d0626f21497e218867a54fd623d889c101bfa1d.gif

Inspired by the early roots of visual novels – from PC-98 to Sega Saturn – the new splash artwork features Kinmoku in their studio. If you look closely you can see references to Kinmoku's games, and even their dog, Goro!

To learn more about the developer, please check out the new website at www.kinmoku.games

notes.title: Update 2.252
notes.notes:
Just a small update this time! An achievement bug stopping Chinese and German players from getting "Coincidence much?", "Sure, why not?" and "How unfortunate…" has been fixed.

Some spelling and formatting errors have also been improved.

Thanks again for playing!

notes.title: Update 2.251
notes.notes:
Good news for Chinese and German players!

The bug which was stopping Chinese players from finishing the ending "In a Twist" has been fixed. Small graphical improvements have been made to the Chinese and German versions as well.

Also, there has been an engine update. See https://www.renpy.org/doc/html/changelog.html for more information.

Thank you all for continuing to enjoy One Night Stand!
